mutants.label: [control] drop the fence-length reset on close
mutants.why: fence_len is read only while fence_char is set, and fence_char is set only by the opener branch, which assigns fence_len first; so the value left behind by a closed fence is always overwritten before its next read. Inert on every input, since no path reads fence_len between a close and the next open.
